title: "Packages"

*animovement* is an ecosystem of R packages, each solving one stage of the
movement-analysis workflow. Install the [`animovement`](https://animovement.dev/animovement)
metapackage to get everything at once, or reach for individual packages as you
need them.

Each package has its own reference site — click a card to open it.

::: {.package-grid}
[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-hexagon}[animovement]{.package-name}[The metapackage]{.package-role}[Bundles the whole ecosystem and re-exports the most common functions, so one library(animovement) gives you the full workflow.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/animovement){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-box}[aniframe]{.package-name}[Core data structures]{.package-role}[S3 classes and methods for representing and manipulating movement data with consistent, intuitive interfaces.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/aniframe){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-download}[aniread]{.package-name}[Reading & writing]{.package-role}[Read and write movement data from diverse sources, from video tracking systems to trackballs.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/aniread){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-clipboard-check}[anicheck]{.package-name}[Data quality]{.package-role}[Diagnostic tools for assessing data quality, identifying missing values, temporal gaps and spatial outliers.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/anicheck){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-gear}[aniprocess]{.package-name}[Processing & filtering]{.package-role}[Filter, smooth and process movement trajectories with advanced signal-processing techniques.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/aniprocess){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-bounding-box}[anispace]{.package-name}[Spatial transformations]{.package-role}[Spatial transformation methods for movement data — reproject, rescale and reframe trajectories in space.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/anispace){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-bar-chart}[animetric]{.package-name}[Metrics]{.package-role}[Calculate movement-based metrics including kinematics, navigational statistics and social interaction measures.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/animetric){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-graph-up}[anivis]{.package-name}[Visualization]{.package-role}[Plotting methods for trajectories, diagnostic summaries and calculated metrics, with publication-ready outputs.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/anivis){.package-card}
:::

## The metapackage

The [`animovement`](https://animovement.dev/animovement) metapackage bundles the
whole ecosystem and re-exports the most common functions, so a single
`library(animovement)` gives you the full workflow. Its reference site documents
its own functions — for cross-package workflows, head to [Learn](../learn/index.qmd).
